title: Concept: Block values used as randomness (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity, a hash over block values produces a result that block producers can predict or steer. Predictable chance lets an attacker win lotteries and games. The remedy is a commit-reveal scheme or a verifiable randomness oracle.
applicability: solidity contracts with games, lotteries, or selection logic; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Predictable outcomes and unfair selection; MEDIUM severity.
